story.title: Akshay Kumar says he sold a producer's tape recorder to recover Rs 32,000
story.summary: During a revealing discussion, Akshay Kumar and Ravi Kishan talked about their battles with unpaid dues in the Indian film sector. Ravi highlighted an unfortunate encounter with a producer who defaulted on payment for 'Udhar Ki Zindagi', whereas Akshay recounted a resourceful effort involving a tape recorder to secure due earnings.

story.title: Rajinikanth earned JUST Rs 2,000 for THIS film
story.summary: The film 'Moondru Mudichu', released in 1976, was pivotal in shaping Rajinikanth's career alongside Kamal Haasan and Sridevi. As a romantic thriller, it showcased Rajinikanth's talent, despite him earning a modest Rs 2,000 compared to Kamal's Rs 30,000. Today, almost fifty years later, it's thrilling to acknowledge that these legends are gearing up to share the screen once more in a new project.

story.title: Centre proposes freeze on Lok Sabha seat proportions for States until 2051
story.summary: The new Constitutional Amendment Bill, accompanied by a fresh Delimitation Bill, proposes to increase the number of Lok Sabha seats in each State by 50%; they also bring into force the 33% reservation for women in the Lok Sabha
